plan.understanding: Add retaining cylindrical heads to both axial ends of all four long Z-axis pins so the link arms cannot slip over the pin ends.

subtasks.goal: On body s1, add one coaxial cylindrical retaining head at each end of the GREEN long pin shaft (face #30, r=2.4 mm, axis [0,0,1], centerline [42.743,1.753,*], end edges [65,71]). Make each head 8.0 mm diameter, exceeding the RED 5.0 mm link-arm bores, with 1.2 mm total axial thickness and 1.0 mm projection beyond the existing pin ends: lower head Z=-27.496..-26.296 mm and upper head Z=27.304..28.504 mm. Unite both heads to s1 and verify they are centered at X=42.743, Y=1.753 mm; print the achieved centers and Z extents and correct them in the same attempt if displaced.
